sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 262810, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $10/night single site, $20/night double site (2026 rate table, all year). The only site the catalog opens to RVs is the double 08/10 ($20); the single sites list tents and trailers.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/262810/rates (Peak Season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 10, double 20) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/oyster-point-campground ('$10/night for single sites; $20/night for double sites'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 262810 (all 15 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 15 campsites, all back-in, driveways 33-108 ft. Equipment allowed per the catalog: RV only at double site 08/10; trailers at 01-05, 11, 14, 15; the rest tent only.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/262810 ('The campground features 15 campsites') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (equipment, Driveway Entry, Driveway Length), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov lists two vault toilets; the Forest Service page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site.' No drinking water. Hand launch only (no vehicle access to the water).

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/262810 ('15 campsites and two vault toilets') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/oyster-point-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations 'must be made 3 days in advance'; one site is first-come, first-served (Scan & Pay only for that site; check with the host before paying). 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Closes ahead of hurricanes; reservations are then cancelled and refunded.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/262810 (Overview; rules reservationCutOff 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/oyster-point-campground ('Reservations will be automatically cancelled and refunded in the event of a closure due to hurricanes'), read 2026-10-22

note: Croatan NF campground on the Newport River near Newport, a short drive from Atlantic Beach; trailhead of the 21-mile Neusiok Trail, with a hand launch for canoes and kayaks. Two-dog limit. Closes temporarily ahead of hurricanes and tropical storms - check the forecast. --Claude
summary: Open (FS 'Site Open'). Confirmed 15 sites, no electric, $10 (2026), reservable on rec.gov 3 days ahead with one first-come site, 14-night limit. Changed nightly_high 10 -> 20 (double sites). Added year-round, all back-in, vault toilets, no drinking water. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Fit: the rec.gov catalog allows RV equipment only at double site 08/10 ($20); eight single sites allow trailers and six are tent only. A 23-ft motorhome may be held to 08/10.

Waterfront re-audit lead: rec.gov says the campground 'is located on the banks of the Newport River' and the FS page 'situated on the Intercoastal Waterway'; the entry is 'not waterfront'. Not changed.
Facilities conflict: rec.gov lists 'two vault toilets', the FS page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site.' Recorded vault_toilets true with the conflict in the note.
